<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex045042026-03-2013-18-28" status="reviewed">3 pa bshad tshul 2 <expan>gsung</expan> pa'i dgos pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">sngon gyi mkhas mchog phya pa <expan>chen po</expan></rs> laswo pas ¦ <expan>grags</expan> pa la <expan>2 te</expan>: brda'i grags pa dang ¦ tha snyad kyi <expan>grags</expan> pa 2 ¦ 
               <expan>de dag</expan> sgrub par byed <expan>pa'i</expan> <expan>gtan tshigs</expan> kyang <expan>2 te</expan> | 
               <expan>gzhan</expan> sel phyin ci log <lb n="106b4"/> <expan>pa'i</expan> sgras zhen su sgrub pa la <expan>phyogs chos</expan> dang khyab pa tshang ba'i <expan>rtags</expan> ni ¦ tha snyad kyi <expan>grags</expan> pa sgrub <expan>pa'i</expan> <expan>rtags</expan> yin la de yang <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> de'i khyas bya <expan>rtags su</expan> byas mtshon bya sgrub pa ste ¦ nogs lkog shal dang ldan pas ba lang gi tha <expan>snyad dang</expan> ¦ sha pas shing gi tha snyad sgrub pa laswo pa'o || 
               <expan>gzhan</expan> sel phyin ci ma log pas <lb n="106b5"/> <expan>khyad par</expan> du <expan>ma byas</expan> <expan>pa'i phyir</expan> sgra tsaM gyi <expan>rjes dpag</expan> rung sgrub pa la <expan>phyogs chos</expan> dang khyab pa tshang pa'i <expan>rtags</expan> ni ¦ brda'i grags pa sgrub <expan>pa'i</expan> <expan>rtags</expan> te ¦ 
               de la'ang 2 : sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya sgrub pa la <expan>phyogs chos</expan> dang khyab pa tshang ba'i <expan>rtags</expan> dang ¦ sgra'i zhen <expan>pa'ii</expan> brjod bya sgrub pa la <expan>phyogs chos</expan> dang khyab pa tshang pa'i <expan>rtags so</expan> | <!--Phya pa's position continues up to the refutation by Sa pan, 107a3--></seg></TEI>
